contentRequirements.content:
- Alt text: Supply policy; Intermediary dependence; Central ledger control; Institutional access; Ordering digital payments. Five rows, three columns: potential modern money-system flaw, Bitcoin response, new responsibility/trade-off. Preserve rule verification, irreversible errors, privacy, key protection, mining equipment/energy.
- Editable source: retain separately addressable geometry and live-label regions; later micrographic copy, table cells and data remain editable and translatable. The SVG and PNG are private visual references, not production assets.
- Reference image output: Codex must provide `assets/reference/bd-v-034-ref.svg` and a matching `assets/reference/bd-v-034-ref.png` when the production gate is clear; never JPG.
- Use in colour, grayscale, print, and on a phone: inspect the stated reading order at 960 × 540 and at phone width; distinguish relationships by position, shape or line style as well as colour; retain a white background, generous copy space and live 12pt-or-larger learner text in production. Compare all table rows and column boundaries in grayscale; retain the text equivalent.

Exact source table retained as editable content and accessible text equivalent (current Student Guide at the placement anchor):

| Potential modern money-system flaw | Bitcoin's response | New responsibility or [trade-off](https://programs.myfirstbitcoin.org/lexicon/en/#trade-off) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Supply can change through policy | Predictable issuance and a 21 million maximum | Users must verify and choose to enforce the rules |
| Payments depend on [intermediaries](https://programs.myfirstbitcoin.org/lexicon/en/#intermediary) | Peer-to-peer [transaction](https://programs.myfirstbitcoin.org/lexicon/en/#transaction-tx) network | A valid payment is usually difficult or impossible to reverse |
| A central [ledger](https://programs.myfirstbitcoin.org/lexicon/en/#ledger) keeper controls records | Independent [nodes](https://programs.myfirstbitcoin.org/lexicon/en/#node) share and verify a public [ledger](https://programs.myfirstbitcoin.org/lexicon/en/#ledger) | Public records can reveal links between [transactions](https://programs.myfirstbitcoin.org/lexicon/en/#transaction-tx), even when they do not identify a person by themselves |
| Access depends on an institution | Anyone can use the protocol and control keys | The user must secure keys and backups. |
| A central party orders digital payments | [Proof of work](https://programs.myfirstbitcoin.org/lexicon/en/#proof-of-work) orders [transactions](https://programs.myfirstbitcoin.org/lexicon/en/#transaction-tx) without a central operator | [Mining](https://programs.myfirstbitcoin.org/lexicon/en/#proof-of-work) requires equipment and energy. |

prohibitions: No financial, legal, tax, accounting, compliance or investment advice; no provider recommendation, guaranteed safety/returns/adoption or universal local/legal conclusion.
No real secrets, seed words, private keys, identities, balances, payable addresses, invoices or payment QR data. Fictional payment screens require editable SAMPLE — DO NOT PAY in later production.
Keep user, educator, wallet, service, node, miner and protocol roles distinct; Bitcoin is not stored inside a wallet, miners do not make the rules, and no single controller approves Bitcoin.
No restricted-pilot app links, QR assets, calls to download or assessment/certification evidence.

No crypto hype, gold Bitcoin coins, generic blockchain imagery, corporate-cartoon proportions, gradients, glossy or 3D effects, shadows, decorative clutter, unapproved icons or redrawn official MFB marks.

Reference only: white background; render no visible text, letters, numerals, punctuation, placeholder text or encoded payment data. Preserve all live copy and warnings in this brief and JSON for later editable implementation.
Do not label the middle column `perfect solution` or add unsupported promises.
